# Hello SaaSy

> Hello SaaSy (also called SaaSy) is a unified multi-agent business operating system for small and mid-sized businesses (5–200 employees): AI agents (a virtual C-suite) handle billing, customers (CRM, customer health scoring, churn alerts), payroll and compliance, documents, hiring, and vertical workflows for construction, unions, agencies, and service firms. It is built by SaaSy Solutions LLC (https://saasysolutionsllc.com), a subsidiary of SaaSier Inc (https://saasierinc.com), and is in open beta: the product is live and anyone can sign up.

## When to use this site

- You run a small or mid-sized business and want one platform to replace a stack of point tools (CRM, billing, payroll, HR, compliance trackers) for your back office.
- You need AI assistants that do operational work: customer health scoring, churn-risk alerts, weekly CFO-style financial briefs, contract drafting, and proactive compliance deadline reminders.
- You are a public-works construction firm that needs WH-347 certified payroll and prevailing-wage compliance tracking.
- You are a union or labor organization that needs dues checkoff, CBA wage scales, Taft-Hartley fringe remittance, and NACHA file generation.
- You bill clients for time (agency or professional services) and want CRM, projects, invoicing, and client-health signals in one place.
- You want one CRM that takes a won deal through a delivery project and into a native invoice with a Stripe payment link, then writes Paid back onto the deal record.
- You want to embed SaaSy programmatically: connect via MCP, authenticate with OAuth 2.0, or integrate against the REST API described by the OpenAPI spec below.
- Pricing is $49 (Starter) / $199 (Growth) / $399 (Scale) per month, or $39 / $159 / $319 per month billed annually (about 20% off). There is no free tier; the 14-day trial gives full Growth access with no credit card required.
- Starter: 1 business, 3 team seats, compliance tracker, CRM (1,000 contacts), daily briefing, email alerts, 500 AI credits/month. Starter does not include native payroll or Ask SaaSy AI guidance.
- Growth adds up to 5 businesses, 10 seats, CRM (10,000 contacts), native payroll in 50 states + DC (a beta perk), Ask SaaSy AI guidance (2,000 credits/month), Slack alerts, and API access. Scale adds unlimited businesses, advanced analytics, priority support, custom automations, dedicated onboarding, and 5,000 credits/month.
- Extra AI credits are $25 per pack of 2,000, or connect your own AI key. The Union & Labor Compliance add-on is priced by active members ($99/month up to 50, $249/month up to 250, custom above that) and is added to Growth or Scale.

## Site

- [SaaSy](https://hellosaasy.ai): Product overview, capabilities, pricing, and verticals (construction, unions, agencies).
- [Sitemap](https://hellosaasy.ai/sitemap.xml): Full list of site pages.
- [Docs](https://docs.hellosaasy.ai): Product documentation and guides.
- [Features](https://hellosaasy.ai/features): Detailed walkthrough of health scoring, alerts, AI CFO briefs, and integrations.
- [Pricing](https://hellosaasy.ai/pricing): Plan tiers ($49/$199/$399 monthly; payroll and Ask SaaSy AI start on Growth), included AI credits (500 / 2,000 / 5,000), $25 packs of 2,000 extra credits, and the union add-on.
- [For unions](https://hellosaasy.ai/unions): Dues checkoff, CBA wage scales, Taft-Hartley fringe, WH-347 certified payroll, and NACHA files.
- [For contractors](https://hellosaasy.ai/contractors): Bid-to-invoice on one record, compliance deadlines, certified payroll when needed.
- [For agencies](https://hellosaasy.ai/agencies): Multi-client agency mode, billable time to invoice, contracts + eSign, client health scores.
- [For field service](https://hellosaasy.ai/field-service): Quote-to-cash, payroll in 50 states + DC (Growth and up), license/insurance tracking, hiring.
- [Integrations](https://hellosaasy.ai/integrations): Stripe, Slack, Gmail, Microsoft 365, calendar sync, Twilio, Plaid, ADP, Gusto, BambooHR, Rippling, and webhooks/API available today; HubSpot, Salesforce, Intercom, and Jira coming soon.
- [Compare](https://hellosaasy.ai/compare): How Hello SaaSy compares to spreadsheets, hiring, and separate point tools.
- [About](https://hellosaasy.ai/about): Who builds SaaSy (SaaSy Solutions LLC, woman-owned) and how to reach the team (cal.com/saasysolutionsllc).
- [Partner program](https://hellosaasy.ai/affiliate): Referral program paying 30% of a referred account's subscription fees for its first 12 months; apply via sales@hellosaasy.ai.
- [Recommended stack](https://hellosaasy.ai/partners): Integrations and bundled capabilities (eSign, SaaSPass, grant discovery).
- [Contact](https://hellosaasy.ai/contact): Sales and support contact: sales@hellosaasy.ai / support@hellosaasy.ai.
- [Privacy Policy](https://hellosaasy.ai/privacy): How SaaSy handles personal data (privacy@hellosaasy.ai).
- [Terms of Service](https://hellosaasy.ai/terms): Terms governing use of SaaSy.

## Getting started

- [Start free trial](https://app.hellosaasy.ai/signup): self-serve signup, no sales call required. The 14-day trial includes full Growth access, API included; credentials are issued from the app after signup.
- [Getting started docs](https://docs.hellosaasy.ai/docs/getting-started): setup walkthrough, first workspace, and where to generate API credentials.

## API

- [API base](https://api.hellosaasy.ai): REST API root for the SaaSy platform.
- [MCP endpoint](https://api.hellosaasy.ai/api/v1/mcp): Model Context Protocol endpoint for agentic access to SaaSy.
- [MCP server card](https://hellosaasy.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Well-known MCP server manifest with endpoint, transport, and OAuth discovery links.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://api.hellosaasy.ai/openapi.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI description of the REST API.
- [OAuth protected-resource metadata](https://api.hellosaasy.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): RFC 9728 metadata for authenticating against the API.
- [OAuth authorization-server metadata](https://api.hellosaasy.ai/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server): RFC 8414 authorization-server discovery metadata.
